279450752.description:
Long curved metal smoking pipe with a bowl shaped like the head of an elephant. The trunk curves upward and holds a small hanging cone charm, and the lidded bowl has coiled wire detail. The stem is decorated with filigree wirework, flower motifs, rope style bands and an open basket shaped bead. The finish is silver tone.

Condition: Tarnish and darkened patina throughout. Green residue near the base of the trunk. Light scratches and marks along the stem. Some wirework is slightly bent. Mouthpiece tip shows wear.
